name: CheckboxRoot
description: Checkbox that turns an option on or off, or shows a mixed state with `indeterminate`. Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the checkbox as invalid, applying error styles. Sets `aria-invalid` on the `<span>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the checkbox, controlling its width, height, and corner radius, and the size of its check mark.

props.name: checked
props.description:
Whether the checkbox is currently ticked.

To render an uncontrolled checkbox, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
Whether the checkbox is initially ticked.

To render a controlled checkbox, use the `checked` prop instead.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the checkbox is ticked or unticked.

props.name: value
props.description:
The checkbox's value. Identifies it within a [Checkbox Group](https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group), falling back to `name` when omitted.
When submitting a form, a checked box submits `value`; with no `value`, it submits the native "on".

props.name: children
props.description: Element shown inside the checkbox in place of the default `Checkbox.IndicatorPrimitive`, such as a `Checkbox.IndicatorPrimitive` with custom props. Anything other than a single element is ignored and the default indicator is shown.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the hidden input.
Useful when the checkbox is rendered outside the form.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the input element.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether the checkbox is in a mixed state: neither ticked, nor unticked.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: parent
props.description:
Whether the checkbox controls a group of child checkboxes.

Must be used in a [Checkbox Group](https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to tick or untick the checkbox.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must tick the checkbox before submitting a form.

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the checkbox is unchecked.
By default, unchecked checkboxes do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Checkbox.Root.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
